retrieval: BM25 with 300 global candidates. Baselines: up to 8 passages / 8000 serialized characters. Expanded: explicit unique title/ID routing, 3 ranked seed nodes, source-ordered tree expansion within 8000 serialized characters; no passage-count cap. No dense vectors.
scope: Four-task lexical retrieval ablation; source identity + hierarchy expansion. No real dense embeddings or end-to-end router in this experiment.
split: fresh deterministic stratified holdout excluding all previous pilot IDs
